A '''skirmish''' took place aboard the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]-operated [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Phaedacomm]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Under the command of rogue Jedi Master [[Dorjander Kace]], Mandalorian forces infiltrated the station. Although Kace tried to capture it without unnecessary bloodshed, the Mandalorian warriors opened fire. A fight broke out, which resulted in the deaths of the entire station staff. The seizure of Phaedacomm cut off all communications of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine was later [[Raid on Dantooine|targeted]] by the Mandalorians.
